sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: March 26, 1996, long hues of people spilled onto the street outside the New South Wales Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 1996年3月26日，新南威尔士州最高法院外，长长的人群涌向街道，

sentences.en: as they desperately scrambled to gain entry into what was expected to be one of the longest and most highly anticipated criminal trials in the state's history.
sentences.zh: 他们拼命挤进去，想要旁听这场被认为是该州历史上最漫长、最受瞩目的刑事审判之一。

sentences.en: Inside, a skylight in the domed ceiling flooded natural light down into the century-old courthouse,
sentences.zh: 法庭内，圆顶天花板上的天窗将自然光洒进这座百年历史的法院，

sentences.en: illuminating the colonial architecture, mahogany panelling, and gold trim that adorned the cream-coloured walls.
sentences.zh: 照亮了装饰着奶油色墙壁的殖民风格建筑、红木镶板和金色饰边。

sentences.en: Thirty journalists gathered in the press gallery at the rear of the courtroom, representing media outlets from all over the world,
sentences.zh: 三十名记者聚集在法庭后方的媒体席上，他们代表着来自世界各地的媒体机构，

sentences.en: including Australia, the United Kingdom, Germany, and the United States.
sentences.zh: 包括澳大利亚、英国、德国和美国。

sentences.en: Upstairs, the public gallery contained enough seats to facilitate 50 members of the public, a small section of which had been reserved for the family members of the seven victiMs.
sentences.zh: 楼上的公众席设有50个座位，其中一小部分预留给了七名受害者的家属。

sentences.en: To show their support, the New South Wales State Government offered the families financial assistance to help cover travel costs to attend the trial.
sentences.zh: 为了表示支持，新南威尔士州政府为这些家庭提供了经济援助，以帮助支付参加庭审的差旅费。

sentences.en: From an initial pool of over 1,000 potential jurors, eight men and four women had been selected.
sentences.zh: 从最初的1000多名潜在陪审员中，选出了八男四女。

sentences.en: They were briefed over what to expect, and warned they were about to be exposed to a lengthy, graphic,
sentences.zh: 他们听取了关于庭审内容的简报，并被告知即将接触到一场漫长、血腥、

sentences.en: and emotionally distressing trial that was expected to last for up to six months.
sentences.zh: 且令人情绪崩溃的审判，预计将持续长达六个月。

sentences.en: Ian Lloyd, the Senior Crown Prosecutor who had overseen the committal hearing, had since taken a leave of absence,
sentences.zh: 曾负责预审听证会的高级皇家检察官伊恩·劳埃德此后已请假离职，

sentences.en: and Deputy Senior Crown Prosecutor Mark Tedeschi was appointed in his place.
sentences.zh: 副高级皇家检察官马克·特德斯基接替了他的职务。

sentences.en: The trial was overseen by presiding judge, Justice David Hunt, while a team of Task Force air detectives were on constant standby to manage the evidence
sentences.zh: 审判由主审法官大卫·亨特大法官主持，同时一个特别工作组的侦探团队随时待命，负责管理证据

sentences.en: and conduct a follow-up on any questions that may arise.
sentences.zh: 并跟进可能出现的任何问题。

sentences.en: Accused serial killer, 51-year-old Ivan Malat sat motionless before the court, dressed in a navy suit, white shirt, and grey checkered tie.
sentences.zh: 被控连环杀手的51岁伊万·米拉特坐在法庭前一动不动，身穿深蓝色西装、白衬衫，系着灰色格子领带。

sentences.en: He sported a fresh, neat haircut, and his face was cleanly shaven.
sentences.zh: 他理了个清爽利落的发型，脸也刮得很干净。

sentences.en: Above his seat, a small perspex screen had been fitted to protect him from anything that may be hurled towards him from the public gallery.
sentences.zh: 在他的座位上方，安装了一块小型有机玻璃屏，以防公众席上有人向他投掷物品。

sentences.en: He kept his gaze averted from the gallery at all times and expressed no concern, with some witnesses detecting a hint of a smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 他始终避开看向公众席，表现得毫不关心，一些证人甚至察觉到他脸上带着一丝微笑。

sentences.en: At the commencement of Ivan Malat's trial,
sentences.zh: 在伊万·米拉特审判开始时，

sentences.en: a Royal Commission was underway into corruption within the New South Wales Police Force, leading to the expectation his defence team would use this to their advantage
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州警察部队内部的腐败问题正在接受皇家调查委员会的调查，这导致人们预期他的辩护团队会利用这一点，

sentences.en: and allege police had planted evidence to frame their client.
sentences.zh: 声称警方栽赃陷害他们的当事人。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, the defence chose to forego this tactic and instead conceded that a male member of the Malat family
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，辩方选择了放弃这一策略，转而承认米拉特家族的一名男性成员

sentences.en: was responsible for the seven backpacker murders and attempted kidnapping of Paul Onions, but that person wasn't Ivan.
sentences.zh: 应对七起背包客谋杀案和企图绑架保罗·奥尼恩斯的案件负责，但那个人不是伊万。

sentences.en: Their strategy relied on the lack of direct evidence implicating Ivan in the deaths and thus aimed to spotlight his brothers Richard or Wally as the culprit,
sentences.zh: 他们的策略依赖于缺乏将伊万与死亡事件直接联系起来的证据，因此旨在将矛头指向他的兄弟理查德或沃利，

sentences.en: who both adamantly denied the allegations.
sentences.zh: 而这两人都坚决否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: In his opening address,
sentences.zh: 在开庭陈词中，

sentences.en: Prosecutor Mark Tedeschi acknowledged the Crown's uncertainty over how many perpetrators were in the forest at the time of the murders
sentences.zh: 检察官马克·特德斯基承认，控方对于谋杀发生时森林里有多少名行凶者并不确定，

sentences.en: and admitted they were unable to prove whether the accused acted alone.
sentences.zh: 并承认他们无法证明被告是否单独作案。

sentences.en: Instead, their efforts were centred around proving Ivan Malat's specific involvement in the crimes, believing he was still legally responsible for the deaths,
sentences.zh: 相反，他们的工作重点是证明伊万·米拉特在这些罪行中的具体参与情况，认为无论他是否有同伙，

sentences.en: regardless of whether or not he had an accomplice or accomplices.
sentences.zh: 他在法律上都应对这些死亡事件负责。

sentences.en: Tedeschi explained the murders were,
sentences.zh: 特德斯基解释说，这些谋杀案是……

sentences.en: While the prosecution case was circumstantial,
sentences.zh: 虽然控方的案件属于间接证据，

sentences.en: Tedeschi established their strategy was to hone in on the discovery of key pieces of evidence that linked Ivan to both the victims and their deaths.
sentences.zh: 但特德斯基确立了他们的策略，即专注于发现将伊万与受害者及其死亡联系起来的关键证据。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, a total of 145 witnesses were called to testify, including many members of the Malat family, experts from a variety of fields,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，总共传唤了145名证人出庭作证，其中包括许多米拉特家族成员、各领域的专家，

sentences.en: and members of the victims' families.
sentences.zh: 以及受害者的家属。

sentences.en: Joanne Walter's mother, Jillian, broke down on her way to the witness box and was unable to testify, her emotional turmoil clear to all observers, except the accused,
sentences.zh: 乔安妮·沃尔特的母亲吉莉安在走向证人席时崩溃了，无法作证，她的情绪波动在所有旁观者眼中显而易见，除了被告，

sentences.en: who showed no reaction.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何反应。

sentences.en: At one stage, the jurors were escorted into Belangelo State Forest to inspect the remote locations where the murders took place,
sentences.zh: 有一次，陪审员们被带到贝兰格罗州立森林，实地考察谋杀发生的偏远地点，

sentences.en: in an effort to enable them to better understand the evidence presented in court.
sentences.zh: 旨在让他们更好地理解法庭上提交的证据。

sentences.en: At the advice of his legal team,
sentences.zh: 在法律团队的建议下，

sentences.en: Ivan admitted that the camping-related items seized from his home and the homes of several of his family members did indeed belong to some of the deceased backpackers.
sentences.zh: 伊万承认，从他家和他几位家人的家中查获的露营用品确实属于一些已故的背包客。

sentences.en: He accepted the tent, water bottle, sleeping bag, and sleeping bag cover found at his property belonged to Simone Schmiddle, as did the daypack located at his brother Wally's home
sentences.zh: 他承认在他住所发现的帐篷、水壶、睡袋和睡袋套属于西蒙妮·施米德尔，在他兄弟沃利家中发现的日用背包也是如此，

sentences.en: and the backpack handed to police by his brother Alex and his wife Joan.
sentences.zh: 还有他兄弟亚历克斯及其妻子琼交给警方的背包。

sentences.en: He also admitted that two sleeping bags, a sleeping mat, and a tent recovered from his brother Richard's home belonged to Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark.
sentences.zh: 他还承认，从他兄弟理查德家中找回的两个睡袋、一个防潮垫和一个帐篷属于乔安妮·沃尔特和卡罗琳·克拉克。

sentences.en: Wally Mallatt testified that at the height of Task Force Ayers' investigation, he allowed Ivan to store various incriminating items on his property.
sentences.zh: 沃利·米拉特作证说，在特别工作组调查的高峰期，他允许伊万将各种罪证物品存放在他的房产内。

sentences.en: This included several illegal firearms, and what Wally later learned after Ivan's arrest was Simone's daypack.
sentences.zh: 这包括几支非法枪支，以及沃利在伊万被捕后才知道的西蒙妮的日用背包。

sentences.en: In Richard Mallatt's court testimony, he maintained the camping equipment recovered from his home was his, even though Ivan had already conceded
sentences.zh: 在理查德·米拉特的法庭证词中，他坚称从他家中找回的露营装备是他自己的，尽管伊万已经承认

sentences.en: it belonged to Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark.
sentences.zh: 这些物品属于乔安妮·沃尔特和卡罗琳·克拉克。

sentences.en: Ivan's girlfriend, Chalinda, was called to explain how she came to be photographed wearing a long-sleeved Benetton brand shirt matching one owned by Caroline Clark.
sentences.zh: 伊万的女友查琳达被传唤出庭，解释她为何会被拍到穿着一件与卡罗琳·克拉克拥有的同款长袖贝纳通衬衫。

sentences.en: Chalinda said she had taken the shirt from a pile of ironing at Ivan's Eaglevale property one morning in 1994,
sentences.zh: 查琳达说，1994年的一天早上，她从伊万位于伊格尔维尔的房产里的一堆熨烫衣物中拿走了这件衬衫，

sentences.en: wearing it to the beach that day where Ivan took the photo of her.
sentences.zh: 那天穿着它去了海滩，伊万在那里给她拍了照。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon, she returned the shirt to the clothes pile and hadn't seen it since.
sentences.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，她把衬衫放回了衣物堆，之后就再没见过它。

sentences.en: During Chalinda's testimony,
sentences.zh: 在查琳达作证期间，

sentences.en: Crown Prosecutor Mark Tedeschi presented the photograph to the court, revealing handwriting on the back of the image that displayed a date.
sentences.zh: 皇家检察官马克·特德斯基向法庭展示了这张照片，照片背面显示有手写的日期。

sentences.en: A time when Ivan was still living at his mother's house in Guildford.
sentences.zh: 那是伊万还住在吉尔福德他母亲家的时候。

sentences.en: The prosecution was also able to connect the defendant to James Gibson's backpack and camera which were found on Galston Gorge Road in northwestern Sydney.
sentences.zh: 控方还成功地将被告与詹姆斯·吉布森的背包和相机联系起来，这些物品是在悉尼西北部的加尔斯顿峡谷路发现的。

sentences.en: Records provided by Ivan's former employer, the Roads and Traffic Authority, confirmed he worked on the construction of a roundabout in the suburb of Jural,
sentences.zh: 伊万的前雇主——道路与交通管理局提供的记录证实，他在朱拉尔郊区的一个环岛施工现场工作，

sentences.en: just a few weeks before James and his partner Deborah Everest went missing.
sentences.zh: 就在詹姆斯和他的伴侣黛博拉·埃弗里斯特失踪前几周。

sentences.en: Galston Gorge Road was along the route
sentences.zh: 加尔斯顿峡谷路是伊万

sentences.en: Ivan had taken when driving to his work site in Drural, indicating he was familiar with the area where the evidence had been dumped.
sentences.zh: 开车去德鲁拉工作地点时经过的路线，这表明他熟悉倾倒证据的区域。

sentences.en: Several of Ivan's former work colleagues and relatives gave evidence regarding his known habit of carrying knives and guns, with one of his nieces stating
sentences.zh: 伊万的几位前同事和亲戚提供了关于他携带刀具和枪支习惯的证据，其中一位侄女说，

sentences.en: he once asked her security guard boyfriend to supply him with a pair of handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 他曾要求她当保安的男友为他提供一副手铐。

sentences.en: Ivan's ex-wife Karen testified against her former husband, referring to four separate occasions throughout their relationship where he took her to Belangelo State ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 伊万的前妻凯伦出庭指控她的前夫，提到了在他们关系期间，他曾四次带她去贝兰格罗州立森林。

sentences.en: During these visits, he didn't require the use of a map as he seemed to know his way around the area.
sentences.zh: 在这些访问期间，他不需要使用地图，因为他似乎对该地区非常熟悉。

sentences.en: Karen professed to seeing Ivan use pieces of sash cord as ropes, and when shown a piece of blue and yellow rope recovered from Gabor Neugebauer and Anya Habschied's crime scene,
sentences.zh: 凯伦声称看到伊万使用窗帘绳作为绳索，当被展示从加博尔·纽格鲍尔和安雅·哈布希德的犯罪现场找回的一根蓝黄色绳子时，

sentences.en: she recognised it as the same type her ex-husband once used to tie her son's go-kart onto the back of a trailer.
sentences.zh: 她认出这就是她前夫曾经用来把她儿子的卡丁车绑在拖车后面的那种绳子。

sentences.en: When questioned about the
sentences.zh: 当被问及

sentences.zh: 在他住所发现的安舒茨步枪，该枪此后已被证实与A区犯罪现场有关时，

sentences.en: Wally Millat testified that the gun belonged to Ivan.
sentences.zh: 沃利·米拉特作证说这把枪属于伊万。

sentences.en: Unprompted,
sentences.zh: 未经提示，

sentences.en: Wally then claimed to have borrowed the firearm in the past to shoot rabbits in Belangelo.
sentences.zh: 沃利随后声称他过去曾借用过这把枪去贝兰格罗打兔子。

sentences.en: The prosecution suspected
sentences.zh: 控方怀疑

sentences.en: Wally was fabricating evidence in an attempt to explain how and why Ivan's weapon was discharged in the forest, but he denied the accusation.
sentences.zh: 沃利是在编造证据，试图解释伊万的武器是如何以及为何在森林中被发射的，但他否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: Despite the prosecution's understanding that Wally was falsifying testimony to protect his older brother, the Defence Council instead argued
sentences.zh: 尽管控方认为沃利是在伪造证词以保护他的哥哥，但辩护律师却辩称，

sentences.en: Wally had an incentive to frame their client for murder.
sentences.zh: 沃利有动机陷害他们的当事人谋杀。

sentences.en: They exposed Ivan's romantic history with Wally's former wife, Maureen, some 15 years prior, but Wally denied harbouring any bitterness about the affair.
sentences.zh: 他们揭露了伊万与沃利的前妻莫琳在大约15年前的恋情，但沃利否认对这段婚外情怀有任何怨恨。

sentences.en: He confessed to knowing the security alarm code to Ivan's house, but rejected allegations that he had planted the Ruger rifle parts inside the property.
sentences.zh: 他承认知道伊万家的安全警报密码，但否认了他在房产内栽赃鲁格步枪零件的指控。

sentences.en: The sense of unwavering loyalty ingrained within the Millat family was further evident during the testimony provided by Ivan's sister-in-law, Carolyn, in which she offered an alibi
sentences.zh: 米拉特家族根深蒂固的忠诚感在伊万的嫂子卡罗琳提供的证词中得到了进一步体现，她为伊万

sentences.en: for Ivan's whereabouts on several key dates that some of the Belangelo victims were abducted.
sentences.zh: 在几名贝兰格罗受害者被绑架的关键日期的行踪提供了不在场证明。

sentences.en: Carolyn took the court back to Boxing Day of 1991, the day Gabor Neugebauer and Anya Habschied disappeared from Sydney.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳将法庭带回到1991年的节礼日，即加博尔·纽格鲍尔和安雅·哈布希德从悉尼失踪的那一天。

sentences.en: She claimed Ivan was present at a family get-together at his mother's home in Guildford and couldn't have left the property at any time because her car was blocking
sentences.zh: 她声称伊万当时在吉尔福德他母亲家参加家庭聚会，不可能在任何时候离开该房产，因为她的车挡住了

sentences.en: the entrance to the garage where his vehicle was parked inside.
sentences.zh: 车库入口，而他的车就停在里面。

sentences.zh: 这一不在场证明得到了沃利妻子的支持，她声称记得在同一次聚会上看到伊万和她的儿子玩耍。

sentences.zh: 在现场。

sentences.zh: 卡罗琳为她的姐夫提供了另一个不在场证明，声称有1992年复活节长周末家庭旅行时伊万的照片，那是乔安妮·沃尔特

sentences.en: and Caroline Clark went missing.
sentences.zh: 和卡罗琳·克拉克失踪的时间段。

sentences.zh: 这些照片存放在一本最初标记为1991年的相册中，但卡罗琳声称在意识到自己犯了错误后，将日期改为了次年。

sentences.en: Insisting the trip occurred in 1992,
sentences.zh: 坚称这次旅行发生在1992年，

sentences.zh: 卡罗琳被要求检查这些照片的背面。

sentences.zh: 上面潦草地写着日期：

sentences.zh: 3月29日和3月31日，
